name: Galeria Acrylic Paint, 20 x 12 ml Tube Set
statusReason: Provisional until Cowork runs the Associates Link Checker on this ASIN (and, for Liquitex, re-reads the seller): then set affiliateLinkEligible to yes and status to verified.
bestUse: Best for painting small decorative clay dishes in soft, matching colours
descriptionOriginal: A box of twenty small tubes of acrylic paint that runs from white and black through brights to soft shades such as Pale Rose Blush, Naples Yellow and Olive Green.
whyWeLikeIt: The soft shades are already in the box, so a blush, a butter yellow and an olive for three matching dishes need no mixing, and a single stronger red can supply the cherry rim. Twenty small tubes go a long way on pieces this size.
limitations: The maker's page does not mention clay, so the only guidance on painting air-dry clay is the clay maker's: paint once the piece is completely dry. It has more colours than three small projects use, the tubes are small, and the page names no finish, so expect to test one colour on a scrap before committing.
qualityNote: Customers call it a good starter set with top-notch quality. No concerns seen when checked.
